task.name: open_drawer_put_stapler
task.description: Use the right arm to open the drawer, then use the left arm to put the stapler inside.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the drawer handle.
2. Grasp the drawer handle with the right arm.
3. Pull the drawer open using the right arm.
4. Move the left arm to approach and align with the stapler.
5. Grasp the stapler with the left arm.
6. Move the left arm to align with the open drawer.
7. Release the gripper to place the stapler inside the drawer.
